title: mcp.tool.ToolAnnotations
description:
Additional metadata about a tool to help clients decide how to display
or control its use.

destructiveHint.description: If true, the tool may perform destructive updates.

idempotentHint.description:
If true, calling the tool repeatedly with the same arguments
has no additional effect.

openWorldHint.description: If true, the tool interacts with the external world.

readOnlyHint.description: If true, the tool does not modify its environment.

title.description: A human-readable title for the tool.
